name: 01-utility
hypothesis: Larger biome; resource utility, committed goals and scouting.
note: 40ms initial implementation. Later candidates introduce 20ms windows; blocked time includes contacts. Swarm measured from actual displacements. Different map/physiology from the historical Insectarium baseline.

name: 02-water
hypothesis: Address measured blocking with neighbour separation; hydration priorities and 20ms neural windows.
note: Measured feature addition; ecological constraints differ by stage. Score is diagnostic, not a controlled causal estimate for every added need. Observed swarm uses actual displacements, at least three moving neighbours within 850cm and alignment >0.65.

name: 03-economy
hypothesis: Fix critical hunger at water and neural feeding activation; carry food to nests and pay for brood.
note: Full 600s run after correcting critical hunger and feeding activation. A prior 156s diagnostic start was aborted and is excluded.
